description: Manage component substitutions in your mapping store. Use it when connecting React/Vue exports or shadcn source to OODS components; use catalog_list to find component names. Returns entries, matches or per-entry write outcomes. action selects draft/show/apply/create/list/resolve/update/delete. draft reads local shadcn or built Storybook files without executing code; show exposes evidence, adapter files and unmatched elements; apply with draftId and accept ids validates and atomically registers reviewed mappings. create accepts a single entry, mappings list or mappingsPath; lists validate completely before one write. substitution supplies exports and prop translations with exact package versions or installed localPath. React/Vue shadcn mappings use an installed project and module instead. Compose snapshots mappings; generation/preview apply them. apply controls mutation where supported. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#component_map; full schema: oods://schemas/component_map.input.json.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler to invoke.

apply.description: For apply: When true, persist registry mutations. Actions: apply, create, list, resolve, update, delete. See full schema for details.

capabilities.description: Draft v1.4.0-gated first-class capability entities to APPEND to the registry's top-level capabilities[]. Each entry uses the Stage1 capability entity shape. Actions: create.

items.description: capabilities item. Fields: entity_type, id, slug, name, canonical_verb, aliases, oods_traits, projection_variant_ids, preconditions, metadata. See full schema.

confidence.description: 'auto' for machine-generated, 'manual' for human-curated. Actions: create.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Use the previous page's nextCursor to continue. When cursor or limit is provided, pagination defaults to 100 items per page. Actions: list.

disambiguation_decisions.description: Draft v1.4.0-gated review-decision events to APPEND to the registry's top-level disambiguation_decisions[]. Additive stub only; does not gate mapping creation. Each entry uses the Stage1 disambiguation_decision shape. Actions: create.

items.description: disambiguation decisions item. Fields: decision_id, decision_type, scope, status, target_kind, target_id, selected_value, rationale, alternatives, preferred_term_id, decided_by, decided_at, metadata. See full schema.

externalComponent.description: For create: Component name in the external system (e.g., 'Button', 'TextField'). For resolve: Component name in the external system (e.g., 'Button'). Actions: create, resolve (required).

externalSystem.description: For create: External design system name (for example, 'team'). Actions: create, list, resolve (required), draft. See full schema for details.

id.description: For update: Mapping ID to update (e.g., 'team-button'). For delete: Mapping ID to delete (e.g., 'team-button'). Actions: update (required), delete (required).

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Omitting both cursor and limit preserves the legacy full-list response. Actions: list.

mappings.description: Create entries, each without apply. All entries are checked before one atomic write. Actions: create.

items.description: A single-create payload without action or apply; the handler checks every value against… See full schema for details.

mappingsPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON document { mappings: [...] }, using the same entry shape. Actions: create.

minConfidence.description: Candidates below this threshold are routed to queued instead of being applied. Actions: apply.

oodsTraits.description: OODS trait names this component maps to. Actions: create.

preferred_terms.description: Draft v1.4.0-gated canonical-term entities to APPEND to the registry's top-level preferred_terms[]. Each entry uses the Stage1 preferred_term entity shape. Actions: create.

items.description: preferred terms item. Fields: entity_type, id, slug, label, aliases, scope, domain, source_decision_ids, metadata. See full schema.

projection_variants.description: Stage1 v1.5.0 cross-surface identity variants. Each element describes one surface-specific projection of this component mapping (desktop/mobile/modal/sidebar). Actions: create.

items.description: projection variants item. Fields: id, surface, external_component, capability_id, selector, confidence, evidence_chain, metadata. See full schema.

propMappings.description: Property translations from external to OODS prop names. Actions: create.

items.description: prop Mappings item. Fields: externalProp, oodsProp, coercion. See full schema.

reportPath.description: Filesystem path to a reconciliation_report.json artifact. Actions: apply.

substitution.description: Version 2 component substitution: an OODS Foundry id, React and/or Vue package exports, and OODS Foundry-to-team prop translations. Legacy trait-only mappings remain valid. Actions: create.

component.description: The shipped OODS Foundry component id being replaced.

react.description: react. Fields: localPath, package, export, version, passthrough, props, shadcn. See full schema.

vue.description: vue. Fields: localPath, package, export, version, passthrough, props, shadcn. See full schema.

updates.description: Fields to update. Only provided fields are changed. Actions: update (required).

projection_variants.description: Replace Stage1 v1.5.0 cross-surface projection variants. See full schema for details.

items.description: projection variants item. Fields: id, surface, external_component, capability_id, selector, confidence, evidence_chain, metadata. See full schema.
